articles.title: Understanding the organization
articles.requirement: Determine external and internal issues relevant to the BCMS purpose and that affect ability to achieve intended outcomes

articles.title: Interested parties needs and expectations
articles.requirement: Determine interested parties relevant to the BCMS, their requirements, and applicable legal/regulatory requirements

articles.title: BCMS scope determination
articles.requirement: Define boundaries and applicability of the BCMS — products, services, activities, locations, supply chains in scope

articles.title: Business continuity management system
articles.requirement: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve a BCMS, including needed processes and their interactions

articles.title: Leadership and commitment
articles.requirement: Top management shall demonstrate leadership — establish BC policy, ensure resources, direct and support persons, promote improvement

articles.title: Business continuity policy
articles.requirement: Establish a BC policy appropriate to the organization's purpose, providing a framework for objectives, commitment to requirements

articles.title: Organizational roles and responsibilities
articles.requirement: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for BCMS roles — including authority for activating business continuity response

articles.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
articles.requirement: Determine risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to give assurance the BCMS achieves its intended outcomes

articles.title: Business continuity objectives
articles.requirement: Establish measurable BC objectives at relevant functions and levels — what, resources, who, when, how evaluated

articles.title: Planning of changes
articles.requirement: When changes to the BCMS are needed, carry them out in a planned and systematic manner

articles.title: Resources
articles.requirement: Determine and provide resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the BCMS

articles.title: Competence
articles.requirement: Determine necessary competence of persons doing work affecting BC performance — ensure through education, training, or experience

articles.title: Awareness
articles.requirement: Persons working under organizational control shall be aware of BC policy, their contribution to BCMS, and implications of non-conformity

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: Determine internal and external communications relevant to the BCMS — including procedures for communicating during disruptions

articles.title: Documented information
articles.requirement: BCMS shall include documented information required by ISO 22301 — creation, updating, control, and retention procedures

articles.title: Operational planning and control
articles.requirement: Plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet BCMS requirements — manage planned changes and unintended consequences

articles.title: Business impact analysis (BIA)
articles.requirement: Conduct BIA to identify activities supporting products/services, assess impacts of disruption over time, set prioritized timeframes for resumption

articles.title: Risk assessment
articles.requirement: Establish and apply a risk assessment process to identify risks of disruption to prioritized activities — analyse and evaluate risks

articles.title: Business continuity strategies and solutions
articles.requirement: Determine and select business continuity strategies and solutions — protect prioritized activities, stabilize, continue, resume, recover

articles.title: Business continuity plans and procedures
articles.requirement: Establish and maintain BC plans — purpose and scope, roles, activation criteria, communication procedures, resource requirements, recovery procedures

articles.title: Exercise and testing programme
articles.requirement: Conduct exercises and tests that are consistent with BC objectives — validate plans, identify improvements, based on realistic scenarios

articles.title: Evaluation of BC documentation and capabilities
articles.requirement: Evaluate BC documentation and capabilities through review, analysis, and exercises — after incidents, organizational changes, or at planned intervals

articles.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation
articles.requirement: Determine what needs monitoring and measuring, methods, when performed, when results analysed — evaluate BCMS performance and effectiveness

articles.title: Internal audit
articles.requirement: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals — BCMS conforms to requirements and is effectively implemented and maintained

articles.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
articles.requirement: When nonconformity occurs — react, evaluate cause, implement corrective action, review effectiveness, make changes to BCMS if necessary
